seo.title: Contact · Servicely™ (demo)
seo.description: Demo contact page for the fictional Servicely™ platform. The form is rendered, but nobody is at the other end — this is a template, not a real company.

data.headline: ## Get in touch with the *team.*
data.body: A founder reads every message. Expect a real reply within one working day — usually the same day if it's before 6pm CET. (Being honest: this is a demo site, so the messages won't actually go anywhere — but that's exactly how the real form would behave.)
data.quote: The team replied in two hours, on a Sunday. Their CEO debugged my schema bug live on a call. Try getting that from the big platforms.
